## Goal

An open story whose branches still hold `runs/` from an older norn moves each unit's record into the holder's machine dir at its first tick, removes it from each branch in one pushed commit, and goes on at the same step and attempt (B34, D13 steps 1, 3, 4; AC1–AC4).

## Progress

- Observe (store snapshot, effect-free, H2): a story worktree (and each slice worktree) whose tree still holds run-state files in `<spec>/runs/` (`treeRunStateFiles`: everything but the units' handoffs) gives its unit a `branch_record {path, copy}`; units the machine dir holds no state of but that tree does are read from the tree (`tree_root`), so their state and errors are the branch's. `copy` = the units read from that worktree's tree ([] = an interrupted move: only the removal left). A slice's record on the story branch moves with the story unless the slice's own worktree reads it.
- Decide (`moveRecords` in decide/story.ts, before round.migrate): one `move_record` per branch (rule `record.move`; the other units it copies get a `record.move` noop). A flat `_story` record goes to `rounds/01-<wf>` (`roundRunStatePath`). `record.move_waits` when the worktree is mid-merge/rebase (H1) or a record to move failed validation (S2: decideUnit marks the broken unit corrupt, never writing `status: corrupt` into a branch-read record; nothing moves).
- Act (`moveRecord`, act/lifecycle.ts; store `record-move.ts`): `copyTreeRecord` stages each record beside its target without the handoff, validates every state/workflow/receipt (`recordErrors`), then `atomicCopyDir`; skips a target that already has state.json (resumable, AC3). Then `removeTreeRunState` (handoffs kept, empty folders pruned) and one commit of that path only (handoffs excluded by pathspec) "norn: move <unit> run state off the branch", pushed.

Fixture helper `toBranchRunState` in test/support/harness.ts. Hand-built rule cases for `record.move` and `record.move_waits` (packages/core/test/rule-cases.ts).

- Blocking, F1: observe finds the branch's leftover run state by reading the work tree (`treeRunStateFiles`), not the branch's HEAD tree. If `removeTreeRunState` runs but the move commit never lands, the move is never finished, and the deletions are folded into a later unrelated `git add -A` commit. That can happen on a crash, a thrown commit, or a `deferred` commit (moveRecord still returns ok). This breaks D13 ("runs/ still on a held unit's branch", one move commit) and AC3.
- Minor: F2, the bare catches in `treeRunStateFiles`. F3, the story's move deletes a slice's story-branch copy without copying it, even while the slice-branch copy is corrupt. F4, the AC3 fixtures are partly built by hand, one test asserts observe Facts, and `record.move_waits` has no S1 test. Nit: F5. The findings file has the details.
- Checked and fine: observe writes nothing; S2 (a broken record moves nothing, and nothing is written into a record read from a branch); H1 wait; no handoff move (slice 07 respected); no new skips and no loosened assertions; golden has record.move.
- Tests: unit 1206 pass; integration 726 pass / 6 skip / 0 fail; typecheck green. e2e not rerun (implement reported 71 pass / 2 skip).
- Flakes: none.
- review#1 changes_requested: Blocking F1: observe reads the work tree, not the branch's HEAD tree, so if the files are deleted but the move commit never lands (crash, thrown or deferred commit), the move is never finished and the deletions ride into an unrelated later commit (D13, AC3). ### implement#2 (rework of review#1)

- F1: a move is done only once its commit lands. Observe (run-facts `branchRecord`, effect-free: the worktree's git status it already reads) reports `branch_record {copy: []}` when the worktree no longer holds the files but staged/unstaged deletions under `<spec>/runs/` (not handoffs) are uncommitted. `moveRecord` re-checks `inProgress` before removing anything, and returns ok:false on a deferred or refused commit; a throwing commit fails the action too. The next tick then commits the removal as the one "norn: move … off the branch" commit. New S1 tests: crash after the delete; a failing commit (pre-commit hook) → ok:false, next tick ok with one commit; a merge in progress over leftover deletions → `record.move_waits`, then after `merge --abort` one commit. I chose status over `git ls-tree` because observe already has the status, so there is no extra git call per tick (transcripts unchanged).
- F2: `treeRunStateFiles` catches only ENOENT. F3: `branch_record.holds` (every unit folder on that branch); the move waits while any of those units fails validation. New test "S2: the story's move waits…" (slice 01 broken on its branch, its copy on the story branch kept). F4: `toBranchRunState` gained `broken` and `interrupted: "after copy" | "after removal"`; AC3 tests no longer build fixtures by hand or assert facts. F5: `hasFlatRecord` (steps.ts) shared with round.migrate; loadStories passes its options through; `Dirent` imported.
- Golden: the 2 cases harvested in implement#1 recorded the old facts shape (no `holds`), so I dropped them and harvested again (see below).

- Golden harvest: `golden --update` changed 0 of 117 cases. `bun run golden` added 4: run-state-move-707e07fa5120 and -aa82832cb181 (record.move), -d3886cdae24e and -ce5500940ad7 (record.move_waits); `--update` then changed 0 of 121. Transcripts and observe snapshots: unchanged.
